mapper.select: SELECT /*MenuMapper.selectMenuListByUppMenuId 상위 아이디로 하위 메뉴들을 조회 */ MENU_ID , /*메뉴아이디*/ MENU_NM , /*메뉴명*/ MENU_TYP_CD , /*메뉴유형코드*/ USE_YN , /*사용여부*/ MENU_SEQ , /*메뉴순서*/ MENU_LVL , /*메뉴레벨*/ UPP_MENU_ID , /*상위메뉴ID*/ REGNT_ENO , /*등록자사번*/ TO_CHAR(REG_DTM, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REG_DTM, /*등록일시*/ TRTR_ENO , /*변경자사번*/ TO_CHAR(TRT_DTM, 'YYYYMMDD') AS TRT_DTM /*변경일시*/ FROM S_MG.TB_IMGSYF02 /*메뉴관리기본*/ WHERE UPP_MENU_ID= #{menuId} ORDER BY MENU_LVL, UPP_MENU_ID, MENU_SEQ ASC

SELECT /*MenuMapper.selectMenuListByUppMenuId 상위 아이디로 하위 메뉴들을 조회 */ MENU_ID , /*메뉴아이디*/ MENU_NM , /*메뉴명*/ MENU_TYP_CD , /*메뉴유형코드*/ USE_YN , /*사용여부*/ MENU_SEQ , /*메뉴순서*/ MENU_LVL , /*메뉴레벨*/ UPP_MENU_ID , /*상위메뉴ID*/ REGNT_ENO , /*등록자사번*/ TO_CHAR(REG_DTM, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REG_DTM, /*등록일시*/ TRTR_ENO , /*변경자사번*/ TO_CHAR(TRT_DTM, 'YYYYMMDD') AS TRT_DTM /*변경일시*/ FROM S_MG.TB_IMGSYF02 /*메뉴관리기본*/ ORDER BY MENU_LVL, UPP_MENU_ID, MENU_SEQ ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT /*MenuMapper.insertMenuInfo 메뉴 추가- */ INTO S_MG.TB_IMGSYF02 /*메뉴관리기본*/ ( MENU_ID , /*메뉴아이디*/ MENU_NM , /*메뉴명*/ MENU_TYP_CD , /*메뉴유형코드*/ USE_YN , /*사용여부*/ MENU_SEQ , /*메뉴순서*/ MENU_LVL , /*메뉴레벨*/ UPP_MENU_ID , /*상위메뉴ID*/ REGNT_ENO , /*등록자사번*/ REG_DTM , /*등록일시*/ TRTR_ENO, /*변경자사번*/ TRT_DTM ) /*변경일시*/ VALUES ( #{menuId} , #{menuNm} , #{menuTypCd} , #{useYn} , #{menuSeq} , #{menuLvl} , #{uppMenuId} , #{regntEno} , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , #{trtrEno} , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE /*MenuMapper.updateMenuInfo 메뉴 수정*/ S_MG.TB_IMGSYF02 /*메뉴관리기본*/ SET MENU_ID = #{menuId} , /*메뉴아이디*/ MENU_NM = #{menuNm} , /*메뉴명*/ MENU_TYP_CD = #{menuTypCd} , /*메뉴유형코드*/ USE_YN = #{useYn} , /*사용여부*/ MENU_SEQ = #{menuSeq} , /*메뉴순서*/ MENU_LVL = #{menuLvl} , /*메뉴레벨*/ UPP_MENU_ID = #{uppMenuId} , /*상위메뉴ID*/ TRTR_ENO = #{trtrEno} , /*변경자사번*/ TRT_DTM = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP /*변경일시*/ WHERE MENU_ID= #{menuId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM /*MenuMapper.deleteMenuInfo 메뉴 삭제*/ S_MG.TB_IMGSYF02 /*메뉴관리기본*/ WHERE MENU_ID = #{menuId} /*메뉴아이디*/
mapper.select:
SELECT /*MenuMapper.selectMenuListByAuth 권한에 따른 메뉴 조회*/ MENU_ID /*메뉴아이디*/ ,MENU_NM /*메뉴명*/ ,MENU_TYP_CD /*메뉴유형코드*/ ,USE_YN /*사용여부*/ ,MENU_SEQ /*메뉴순서*/ ,MENU_LVL /*메뉴레벨*/ ,UPP_MENU_ID /*상위메뉴ID*/ ,MAX(NVL(MDFC_PSB_YN,'N')) AS MDFC_PSB_YN /*수정권한여부*/ FROM --역할별 사용자 메뉴 (SELECT /*메뉴아이디*/ AA.MENU_ID /*메뉴명*/ ,AA.MENU_NM /*메뉴유형코드*/ ,AA.MENU_TYP_CD /*사용여부*/ ,AA.USE_YN /*메뉴순서*/ ,AA.MENU_SEQ /*메뉴레벨*/ ,AA.MENU_LVL /*상위메뉴ID*/ ,AA.UPP_MENU_ID /*수정권한여부*/ ,BB.MDFC_PSB_YN AS MDFC_PSB_YN FROM S_MG.TB_IMGSYF02 AA /* 메뉴관리기본 */ LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT B.AUTH_ROL_ID /*권한역할ID*/ ,C.MENU_ID /*메뉴ID*/ ,B.MDFC_PSB_YN /*수정권한여부*/ FROM S_MG.TB_IMGSYF03 A /*역할기본 테이블*/ , S_MG.TB_IMGSYF04 B /*역할별사용자기본*/ , S_MG.TB_IMGSYF05 C /*역할별메뉴기본*/ WHERE A.AUTH_GRP_TYP_CD = '2' --역할 /*권한그룹유형코드*/ AND A.AUTH_GRP_ID = B.AUTH_ROL_ID /*권한그룹ID*/ AND B.USER_ID = #{userId} /*사용자ID*/ AND B.AUTH_RET_YN = 'Y' /*권한보유여부*/ AND A.AUTH_GRP_ID = C.AUTH_ROL_ID /*권한그룹ID*/ ) BB ON AA.MENU_ID = BB.MENU_ID WHERE 1=1 AND AA.USE_YN = 'Y' /*사용여부*/ START WITH AA.MENU_ID IN (SELECT /*메뉴ID*/ C.MENU_ID /*메뉴ID*/ FROM S_MG.TB_IMGSYF03 A /*역할기본 테이블*/ ,S_MG.TB_IMGSYF04 B /*역할별사용자기본*/ ,S_MG.TB_IMGSYF05 C /*역할별메뉴기본*/ WHERE A.AUTH_GRP_TYP_CD = '2' --역할 AND A.AUTH_GRP_ID = B.AUTH_ROL_ID AND B.USER_ID = #{userId} AND B.AUTH_RET_YN = 'Y' AND A.AUTH_GRP_ID = C.AUTH_ROL_ID ) CONNECT BY PRIOR AA.UPP_MENU_ID = AA.MENU_ID
UNION ALL
--역할별 조직 메뉴 SELECT AA.MENU_ID /*메뉴아이디*/ ,AA.MENU_NM /*메뉴명*/ ,AA.MENU_TYP_CD /*메뉴유형코드*/ ,AA.USE_YN /*사용여부*/ ,AA.MENU_SEQ /*메뉴순서*/ ,AA.MENU_LVL /*메뉴레벨*/ ,AA.UPP_MENU_ID /*상위메뉴ID*/ ,'N' AS MDFC_PSB_YN /*수정권한여부*/ FROM S_MG.TB_IMGSYF02 AA /* 메뉴관리기본 */ WHERE 1=1 AND AA.USE_YN = 'Y' START WITH MENU_ID IN (SELECT C.MENU_ID FROM S_MG.TB_IMGSYF03 A /*역할기본 테이블*/ , S_MG.TB_IMGSYF06 B /*역할자동부여기본*/ , S_MG.TB_IMGSYF05 C /*역할별메뉴기본*/ WHERE A.AUTH_GRP_TYP_CD = '2' --역할 AND A.AUTH_GRP_ID = B.AUTH_ROL_ID AND B.ORG_CD = #{orgNo} AND A.AUTH_GRP_ID = C.AUTH_ROL_ID ) CONNECT BY PRIOR AA.UPP_MENU_ID = AA.MENU_ID ) GROUP BY MENU_ID ,MENU_NM ,MENU_TYP_CD, USE_YN, MENU_SEQ, MENU_LVL, UPP_MENU_ID ORDER BY MENU_LVL, UPP_MENU_ID, MENU_SEQ ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE /*MenuMapper.updateSubMenuList 하위 메뉴/화면들의 useYn 을 일괄 변경*/ S_MG.TB_IMGSYF02 /* 메뉴관리기본 */ SET USE_YN = #{useYn} /*사용여부*/ ,TRTR_ENO = #{trtrEno} /*처리자사번*/ ,TRT_DTM = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP /*처리일시*/ WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(UPP_MENU_ID) LIKE UPPER(#{menuId}||'%')
mapper.delete: DELETE /*MenuMapper.deleteMenuInfoByMenu 상위 하위 메뉴/화면들을 일괄 삭제 */ FROM S_MG.TB_IMGSYF02 /* 메뉴관리기본 */ WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(UPP_MENU_ID) LIKE UPPER(#{menuId}||'%') /*상위메뉴아이디*/
